title: Pretraining-Based Natural Language Generation for Text Summarization
answer_short: It allows the decoder to generate more fluent and natural sequences by leveraging BERT's contextualized representations, similar to the cloze task in BERT's pre-train process.
answer_rationale: Masking words in the decoder is helpful because it enables the refine decoder to predict refined words one by one, based on the source document and other words in the summary. This process mimics the cloze task in BERT's pre-training, allowing the decoder to utilize BERT's contextualized representations to generate more fluent and natural sequences. The refine decoder shares parameters with the draft decoder, and the masking process ensures that the input sequence is consistent with BERT's pre-training process, enhancing context-aware word representations.
